title: Docker job fails to download pinned checkout action from codeload.github.com
signature: resource temporarily unavailable codeload.github.com failed to download action archive after 3 attempts|Network

failed_jobs.name: Docker
failed_jobs.symptom: Step 'Run ./.github/actions/handle_docker' failed because the runner could not download the pinned 'ababushk/checkout' action archive from codeload.github.com after 3 retries

key_errors: ##[warning]Failed to download action 'https://codeload.github.com/ababushk/checkout/tar.gz/9bec46a94a83db82acd4303e7627d88db71402a5'. Error: Resource temporarily unavailable (codeload.github.com:443)
##[warning]Failed to download action 'https://codeload.github.com/ababushk/checkout/tar.gz/9bec46a94a83db82acd4303e7627d88db71402a5'. Error: Resource temporarily unavailable (codeload.github.com:443)
root_cause: The 'Docker' job's 'Run ./.github/actions/handle_docker' step references the pinned action 'ababushk/checkout@9bec46a94a83db82acd4303e7627d88db71402a5'. The GitHub Actions runner needed to download this action's archive from codeload.github.com before executing the step, but all 3 download attempts (with exponential backoff of ~19s and ~12s between retries) failed with 'Resource temporarily unavailable (codeload.github.com:443)'. This is a transient network/connectivity error on GitHub's codeload CDN endpoint, unrelated to the triggering commit (e51a8dc, a GPU paged-attention kernel-selection performance change) which never touches workflow or action code.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reliably reproducible locally since it depends on transient connectivity between the GitHub Actions runner and codeload.github.com at action-download time. To observe the failure mode, attempt to fetch https://codeload.github.com/ababushk/checkout/tar.gz/9bec46a94a83db82acd4303e7627d88db71402a5 during a codeload outage or from a network path with connectivity issues to GitHub's CDN.
recommended_actions: Re-run the 'Docker' job/workflow; this is a transient codeload.github.com availability issue, not a code regression from commit e51a8dc.

If this action-download failure recurs frequently, consider increasing the runner's action-download retry count/backoff via GITHUB_ACTIONS_RUNNER settings, or self-hosting/mirroring frequently used third-party actions (like the pinned 'ababushk/checkout' fork) in an internal registry to reduce dependence on codeload.github.com.
Monitor GitHub's status page (githubstatus.com) around 2026-10-30T06:07-06:08Z for any reported codeload/Actions incidents correlating with this failure.
prevention_strategies: Reduce blast radius of codeload outages by minimizing reliance on third-party forked actions pinned by commit SHA where possible, or by caching/vendoring critical custom actions (such as the 'handle_docker' composite action's dependencies) within the repository itself so they do not require a live download from codeload.github.com on every job run.
historical_context: A related but distinct Network-category pattern (signature_hash eeae3ce3f5218e80, 'Post-commit jobs fail checkout/fetch with DNS resolution failure (Could not resolve host: github.com)') was previously recorded on 2026-10-13, also a transient GitHub-side connectivity issue but manifesting as a DNS resolution failure during git fetch rather than an action-archive download timeout from codeload.github.com. No prior occurrence of this exact codeload.github.com action-download signature was found in the pattern database; this is the first recorded instance.
